result:
- 答案：已完成。通过 playwright-cli 把 `**/api/users*` 路由 mock 为返回空数组 `[]` 后访问 http://localhost:4399/users，页面渲染出空状态（🪴 图标 + "暂无成员，去邀请第一位伙伴吧" 提示 + "邀请成员" 按钮），截图已保存到 `/Users/bytedance/Code/garden-lab/apps/browser-tool-bench/results/formal-2026-06-12-pw/pw-T04.png`。
- 操作清单：
  1. `playwright-cli --help`（学习用法，含分页查看）
  2. `playwright-cli route --help` / `playwright-cli screenshot --help`
  3. `mkdir -p .../results/formal-2026-06-12-pw`（创建输出目录）
  4. `playwright-cli open`
  5. `playwright-cli route "**/api/users*" --status 200 --content-type "application/json" --body "[]"`
  6. `playwright-cli goto http://localhost:4399/users`
  7. 查看页面快照确认空状态（cat 快照 yml）
  8. `playwright-cli screenshot --filename .../pw-T04.png`
  9. 读取截图文件确认内容正确
  10. `playwright-cli close`
- 卡点：无
